items.title: Jeers again as home woes continue - Jaissle has big problems at Newcastle
items.description: Three months into a four-year contract, the problems are mounting for Newcastle boss Matthias Jaissle after his side were booed off the pitch by their own fans following another defeat.

items.title: From nightmare debut season to Everton hero - Barry's revival
items.description: Last season Thierno Barry scored eight goals in 41 appearances. This season it's taken him just 12 games to match that tally.

items.title: Grealish can still have Everton future - Moyes
items.description: Everton boss David Moyes says there is a way back for Jack Grealish at the club - but does not know when he might return to the team.

items.title: Who has made Troy's Premier League team of the week?
items.description: After every round of Premier League matches this season, Troy Deeney gives us his team of the week. Do you agree with his choices?

items.title: Jaissle unhappy with 'clear foul' before Barry goal
items.description: Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle takes issue with referee John Brooks' decision not to call a "clear foul" on Fabian Schar in the build-up to Thierno Barry's goal in their loss to Everton in the Premier League.

items.title: Everton latest: Moyes unsure if Grealish will be available for Coventry
'He's unavailable' - Moyes tight-lipped on Grealish
items.description: Everton manager David Moyes' post-match reaction to his side's one-goal win against struggling Newcastle United, as well as the availability of Jack Grealish following disciplinary action.

items.title: Papers: Kroupi and Yildiz on Arsenal's radar ahead of January window
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...

items.title: Newcastle latest: Jaissle responds to boos but feels Everton winner shouldn't have stood
Everton hold off Newcastle to move into seventh
items.description: Thierno Barry scores against Newcastle United for the second time in five days as his Everton side earn a narrow win at St James' Park in the Premier League.

items.title: Carragher: Boring Newcastle face a tough season ahead
items.description: Jamie Carragher described Newcastle as flat and boring following their defeat to Everton on Monday Night Football and reckons Matthias Jaissle's side faces a difficult season.

items.title: Arsenal want Kroupi in January - Tuesday's gossip
items.description: Arsenal want to boost their striking options with Bournemouth's Eli Junior Kroupi, Manchester United scout Borussia Dortmund quartet, plus more.
